reviews.title: No way to contact
reviews.text: Urgent developer response requested.  Something happened between this new update.  The app no longer connects.   For me the app suddenly doesn’t work, doesn’t connect, just keeps trying over and over, and then gives red line failed.  I notice that the WiFi symbol never goes out like it used to.  It stays on all the time.  Not sure if this piece of information helps tix the problem.  Sorry no way to contact, need VPN to reach you.  Day 5 without any ability to make a connection.  Just updated, and guess what?  Still no ability to connect.  I finally had to download another company’s service because I need this!  And it works flawlessly.  I see no response from the developer after all this time.  3 weeks or so, I’ve forgotten.  So, I probably will not renew my subscription after all these years, the product just doesn’t work anymore.   Why is there still not developer response?  I paid for the annual fee and haven’t been able to use the software now form more than a month!
